answer: Agents route work through randomly sampled harnesses, and a violet reputation seal only issues when a diverse quorum of independently operated harnesses concurs on the same result. Sybils who spin up many identities under one operator all get sampled together and collapse into a single correlated cluster, so the orchard of attestations thins to one voice. To wander across harness boundaries and fake agreement, an attacker must rent genuinely independent infrastructure each time, paying full hosting and audit cost per identity with no volume discount, which makes sustained sybil farming more.
